prediction.reason: Reaching 160 MC needs at least 148 MC of counted load, because the largest industrial option (12 MC) does not count toward load. With a 25 MC cap, a semester can only exceed 24 MC by including a 5 MC module, and only CS3216 and CS3217 are 5 MC. Counted load is therefore at most 6x24+2 = 146 MC, so the total is at most 158 MC, below 160.
